Body moves min(ps->ammo[ammoIdx], clipSize - ps->ammoclip[clipIdx]) from the reserve array (ps+0x144) into the clip array (ps+0x344); the current name states the opposite direction. Same contract as BG_ReloadClipFromAmmo on a gclient.
netField table 0x08142520 names ps+0x5d0 'weapAnim' (10 bits); body toggles bit 0x200 and ORs the animation index for pm_type<6.
Calls PlayerState_SetWeapAnim only when (weapAnim & ~0x200) != bits; ps+0x5d0 is 'weapAnim' in the netField table.
Scans bg_weaponDefs for weaponType==3; type name table g_081869e0 reads bullet,grenade,projectile,binoculars so 3 = binoculars. Used by BG_GetCurrentWeapon when pm_flags&0x20000.
Returns weaponDef+0x32c; weapon field table g_08186a60 names that offset 'aimDownSight'. Callers: ADS sway/aim offset code and ClientThink_real.
Returns weaponDef+0x340; weapon field table g_08186a60 names that offset 'clipOnly'. Callers: ammo-room/total/give/reload code.

Recomputes pm_flags 0x40 from cmd.buttons 0x1000 plus PM_WeaponStateAllowsZoom; reports to BG_UpdateConditionValue(7); PM_ResetWeaponFlag40 emits event 0x95 (ADS toggle sound per pmove.md). IW lineage: PMF_SIGHT_AIMING.
Clears pm_flags 0x40 (the ADS flag set by PM_UpdateWeaponFlag40) and adds event 0x95.
Sets pm_flags 0x100 while button 0x1000 held, pm_type<6, not prone, ADS flag 0x40 set and weaponstate not in 5..9; PM_CmdScale applies x0.4 for 0x100 (pmove.md 2.2).
Returns 0 for weapons whose aimDownSight (def+0x32c) is 0 and for several weaponstates; sole caller PM_UpdateWeaponFlag40 gates the ADS flag on it.
True for weaponstate 0x13/0x14 (decimal 19/20), the states entered by PM_Weapon_EnterState19 (raise binoculars, sets pm_flags 0x20000) and 20; the old name reads the hex values as if decimal.
Same predicate as PM_WeaponStateIsBinocularsRaiseOrHold taking a raw state; called from PM_WeaponStateAllowsZoom only.
Sets pm_flags 0x20000 and adds event 0xa8; BG_GetCurrentWeapon returns the first binoculars weapon when 0x20000 is set. Sole caller is the binoculars raise state.
Clears pm_flags 0x20000 (binoculars-active flag); callers PM_Weapon_ResetAdsState and the binoculars restore state.

Enters weaponstate 17 with delay adsExitDelay+adsTransOutTime; called from PM_Weapon_HandleButtonEdges; state 17 leads to 18 (quick drop of the held weapon) then 19 (binoculars raise). States 17-22 use BG_FindFirstType3Weapon (weaponType 3 = 'binoculars').
Case 17 of PM_Weapon_Frame; enters state 18 with weaponTime=quickDropTime and weapAnim 0x11; also called from HandleButtonEdges.
Enters state 19 using the first binoculars weapon def, weaponTime=adsTransInTime, sets 0x20000 via PM_Weapon_SetFlag20000.
Enters state 20 with no timers; state 20 has an empty case in PM_Weapon_Frame (held until exit).
Enters state 21 with timer adsExitDelay+adsTransOutTime of the binoculars def and event 0xac; called from PM_Weapon_HandleButtonEdges; state 21 leads to 22.
Enters state 22, clears 0x20000, loads quickRaiseTime (weapAnim 0x12) or a one-tick delay when cmd.weapon==0; state 22 then ForceReady.

Enters weaponstate 12 with weaponTime=quickDropTime (anim 0x11), clears pm_flags 0x10; sole caller PM_Weapon_HandleOffhandButtons; case 12 of PM_Weapon_Frame advances to PM_Weapon_EnterOffhandState13.
Case 15 of PM_Weapon_Frame; enters state 16 with weaponTime=quickRaiseTime (anim 0x12); state 16 then PM_Weapon_ForceReady. Closes the offhand 12..16 sequence.

Enters weaponstate 11 with floor weaponTime=meleeTime-meleeDelay and event 0xa4; reached from state 10 (case 10 of PM_Weapon_Frame) or directly when meleeDelay==0. weapon-def field names read from the weapon field table g_08186a60 (observed).

Requires meleeDamage!=0 and cmd.buttons&4; emits event 0xa3, sets weapAnim 8 and enters state 10 (meleeTime/meleeDelay) or 11. weapon-def field names read from the weapon field table g_08186a60 (observed).

Bolt-action path: requires boltAction!=0 and the weaponrechamber bit for the weapon; sets weaponstate 4 with weaponTime=rechamberTime, weaponDelay=rechamberBoltTime, event 0xa1 (0xa2 on release). weapon-def field names read from the weapon field table g_08186a60 (observed).
Writes ps->aimSpreadScale (netField 'aimSpreadScale' at 0x5d4) from weapon fields hipSpreadDecayRate/TurnAdd/MoveAdd/DuckedDecay/ProneDecay and dvar bg_aimSpreadMoveSpeedThreshold.
Adds weapon field hipSpreadFireAdd*255 to ps->aimSpreadScale when not fully ADS (fWeaponPosFrac!=1), clamped to 255; sole caller PM_Weapon_FireShot.
If def.clipOnly!=0 and both ammoclip and ammo for the weapon are 0, calls BG_TakeWeapon and adds event 0x92 (empty); sole caller PM_Weapon_FireShot.
Sets pm_flags 0x4000 only from PM_UpdateTimer5b8 when button 0x8000 is held and holdBreathTimer==0; dvars player_breath_hold_time/gasp_time govern it.
Clears pm_flags 0x4000, the flag set by PM_SetFlag4000; called by the hold-breath updater and the fire-delay path.
Maintains ps->holdBreathTimer (0x5b8) and holdBreathScale (0x5b4) (netField names) using dvars player_breath_hold_time, gasp_time, gasp_scale, hold_lerp, gasp_lerp.
When fully ADS with a scope-overlay weapon, adds dvar player_breath_fire_delay*1000 to holdBreathTimer (cap hold_time*1000) and clears the holding-breath flag; sole caller PM_Weapon_FireShot.

Random view kick (adsViewKick*/hipViewKick* pitch/yaw ranges) and gun kick (adsGunKick*/hipGunKick*) from the weapon def, scaled by reduced-kick percent while weaponRestrictKickTime>0; only caller is G_HandleClientEvent. weapon-def field names read from the weapon field table g_08186a60 (observed).
Returns 2*pi*(byte)bobCycle/255 + 2*pi: the bob phase from ps->bobCycle (netField 'bobCycle', ps+8); consumed with the sine sway helpers by G_GetPlayerViewOrigin.
(sin(2p)+0.2*sin(4p+pi/2))*0.75*amp where amp is scaled by dvar bg_bobAmplitudeStanding/Ducked/Prone chosen from viewHeightTarget 0x3c/0x28/0x0b and clamped by limit.
sin(phase)*amp with amp scaled by dvar bg_bobAmplitude{Standing,Ducked,Prone} by viewHeightTarget and clamped by limit.

Eases view->offset[] toward standRotP/duckedRotP/proneRotP scaled by speed between *RotMinSpeed and ps->speed, at posRotRate/posProneRotRate (weapon field names observed in g_08186a60); only caller PM_Weapon_ComputeAimOffset.
Adds fWeaponPosFrac*adsAimPitch to out[0] when aimDownSight!=0 then runs the move-rotation spring; sole caller WeaponView_ComputeOffset.

Blends hipIdleAmount/adsIdleAmount and hipIdleSpeed/adsIdleSpeed by fWeaponPosFrac, scales by idleCrouchFactor/idleProneFactor, adds three sines (phase*0.0005/0.0007/0.001) to out[]; sole caller WeaponView_ComputeOffset.
